parts.title: Getting Started
parts.description: What iOS is, how apps get onto an iPhone, installing Xcode, and running your very first app in the Simulator and on your own phone.

parts.title: Swift Essentials
parts.description: The language of modern Apple development. Learn it properly first: values and types, control flow, collections, optionals, structs and classes, protocols, errors and concurrency.

parts.title: Building UI with SwiftUI
parts.description: Build screens declaratively: views and modifiers, stacks and layout, controls, state and bindings, lists and forms, styling, and animation.

parts.title: App Architecture
parts.description: How real apps are structured: the app lifecycle, navigation between screens, the Observation framework and MVVM, and dependency injection.

parts.title: Data & Networking
parts.description: Fetch JSON from web APIs with URLSession and Codable, persist data with SwiftData, store settings and secrets, and make your app work offline.

parts.title: The iOS Platform
parts.description: Links, sharing, permissions and the photo picker, notifications and background work, widgets, and UIKit interop.

parts.title: Quality & Shipping
parts.description: Test with Swift Testing, debug and profile with Instruments, then sign, upload, test with TestFlight and release on the App Store.

parts.title: Capstone: RecipeBox
parts.description: Put everything together and build a complete, production-style SwiftUI app from an empty project to a TestFlight build.
